body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'Surfaces 2009') -- <Visual News> Torlys displayed its leather flooring 'Torlys Leather' at Surfaces 2009 in Las Vegas from Feb. 3-5.

Torlys Leather, popular since its October, 2008 launch, has been a hit with consumers but has gathered a particularly strong following among architects and designers, who have overwhelmingly embraced it. The interior design community is excited about the new product, and many have stepped forward to acclaim its quality and originality.

Leather flooring is sensuous to the touch, and TORLYS Leather is no exception. The floor is an Italian-inspired collection - with names such as Milano Pecan, Catania and Genova Cognac - in rich textures and earth-harmonious colors. Leather adds personality to any room and can be matched with any décor, whether your taste is contemporary, casual or rustic.
In the past, leather floors have been expensive. TORLYS Leather breaks with that tradition: it uses an eco-engineering technology for excellent quality at a very acceptable price.

The raw materials that make up 'Torlys Leather' are natural, non-hazardous and renewable. The top layer is 100% recycled leather. The leftover leather material from the manufacture of belts, jackets and boots is re-used to create beautiful, durable and environmentally friendly floors.
The floor is made with a beneficial acoustic and insulating backing made of up to 100% recycled cork, eliminating the need for a separate underlay.
And 'Torlys Leather' is backed by the Smart Floors guarantee of durability. Every floor is precision-engineered, well-tested for wear, and carries a 25-year wear warranty.
